# Should I take the pension lump sum or the monthly check?

> Free pension lump sum vs monthly pension calculator: the pension's value at your expected return and lifespan, the return the lump sum must earn to match it, break-even age, survivor benefit and what the lump sum could pay each month. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
